title: How can we support you?
description: Ask partners to pick from the church's support menu themselves. Their picks wait for approval before they change the partner's support preferences. Needs Support preferences turned on and a menu in Settings.

survey.title: How can we support you?
survey.intro: We want to care for you in the ways that help most. Tick whatever would be a blessing; leave the rest blank. Nothing changes until someone on our team has looked it over.

questions.label: Is there anything else you would like us to know?
